create.title: Complete metric Fresnel functional calculus and two-character Gram return
create.statement_tex: For the literal collar-extracted hard top M2 coefficient, put c=X/(2gk), K_alpha(u)=e(sgn(alpha)/8)(2|alpha|)^(-1/2)e(-u^2/(4alpha)), T_alpha f=K_alpha*f, and T_0=I. In tempered distributions, Fourier(T_alpha f)(y)=e(alpha y^2)Fourier(f)(y), T_(-alpha)=T_alpha^(-1)=T_alpha^*, and K_alpha tends to delta_0. For the complete punctured metric window W_R(t)=sum_r W_hat_R(r)e(rt), including W_hat_R(0)=mu_R, sum_r W_hat_R(r)T_(rc)=Fourier^(-1) M_(W_R(cy^2)) Fourier exactly. Thus its L2 norm is int |W_R(cy^2)|^2|Fourier(f)(y)|^2dy and its operator norm is ||W_R||_infinity, independent of rho; at y=sqrt(s)-sqrt(h) it reconstructs W_R(Lambda/k). A second quadratic chirp remains in the same metaplectic family with Jacobian |1-4alpha beta|^(-1/2) and a distributional caustic. The signed linear ray factor is chi_4(a)chi_4(a+2q)=(-1)^q, but in the fixed-a shift-v Gram the Fejer sign times the two character pairs is identically one, so no primitive-character autocorrelation remains. At fixed k the sharp ratio band (1-k/J)^(-1)<sqrt(b/a)<1+2k/J has an exact finite triangular Fourier separation of l1 cost O(log N), but its rank factors are jagged and its continuous Mellin kernel has a 1/xi tail. Exact owner conjugation preserves one-count linearly but the accepted aggregate owner bound supplies neither blockwise add-transform-subtract control nor Gram cross energies. At fixed lift the local character dual length is JG and squared coefficient mass is A. Consequently Gaussian separation, separate metric modes, Plancherel, character B-processes, generic theta notation, and transform inversion supply no rho^(-1/2) linear or rho^(-1) energy gain. The actual directional linear or cross-q Gram estimate remains open.
create.next_action: Prove an actual-vector directional estimate outside absolute values: either the character-neutral fixed-a cross-q Gram or a direct signed linear rho^(-1/2) theorem retaining the finite triangular band and conjugated owners. A fixed-K owner completion requires a new blockwise linear one-count norm before it can be used. Do not repeat Gaussian mode opening, separate theta bounds, character B-process inversion, or scalar metaplectic transforms.
create.reason_for_promotion: The Gaussian normalization was independently rederived; discovery and hostile audits proved the stronger exact complete-mode functional calculus, capacity identity, density ownership, character cancellation in the Gram, triangular mask lemma, corrected dual scale, source non-applicability and inversion controls. The statement explicitly leaves all actual-vector cancellation open.

update.next_action: The complete Gaussian metric sum is exactly the original multiplier under Fourier conjugation, and the primitive character cancels in Gram autocorrelation. Prove cancellation of the character-neutral actual cross-q vector, or prove a direct signed linear rho^(-1/2) estimate with all conjugated owners. Separate theta, Plancherel, character-B-process and scalar-transform routes are now closed as sources of free capacity.

The metric density and discrepancies are now proved to be one exact Fourier-conjugated multiplier with unchanged capacity. Close the actual directional hard-block estimate before absolute values; do not split metric modes or infer a gain from the Fresnel prefactor.
First prove the complete actual directional hard-block estimate. Gaussian/two-character separation is an exact equal-capacity return and does not close the cone.

round_assessment.reason: Round 108 converts a formal Gaussian/theta proposal into the exact complete metric functional calculus, proves its equal-capacity return, fixes the character and dual-length ledgers, resolves the sharp finite ratio separation, and hostilely excludes all audited automorphic source maps.
